title: Forge Verifier Contract
description: Mandatory verifier contract for every forge mutation. No verifier = no execution. Verifier must be independent from the mutation implementation. DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI.

capability_id.description: Capability ID of the verification check, e.g. 'system.service.health.read'

implementation_tool.description: MCP tool name used for verification, e.g. 'arif_observe' or 'forge_probe'

expected_schema_version.description: Expected schema version of the verifier's output envelope

success_predicate.description: Condition that must be true for verification to pass

field.description: JSONPath-like field path in the verifier response, e.g. 'status' or 'result.health'

equals.description: Expected value of the field for success

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait for verification

independence_required.description: If true, the verifier must be a different capability/implementation than the mutation. Prevents self-certification.
